content.comment_body: Hello, I have an 80W/24VDC stepper motor ([article_no]). Is [product_name] 24CE able to control this motor using [product_name] Power 24VDC/4.0A and [product_name] Contact 24VDC? I need to manage the motor's speed, direction reversal, and on/off timing. Do I also require some kind of motor driver?

It is strongly advised to use a driver for the stepper motor, regardless of the controller. The [product_name] is not generally designed to control stepper motors directly, as its outputs typically cannot provide suitable frequency pulse signals. If you have a stepper driver that does not require frequency pulses to set the speed, that would be different; however, most drivers need a "step-and-direction" signal pair. Some advanced controllers like [product_name] ([version_no]) can provide this with an integrated axis position controller, but it can be complex to learn and configure. If you are comfortable with microcontroller development boards, you might consider using one instead. Could you provide your specific design criteria?

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to control a stepper motor with [product_name] 24CE together with [product_name] Power and [product_name] Contact modules. Feedback clarifies that the [product_name] platform is not typically suitable for direct stepper motor control due to its output limitations, especially for frequency signals. A dedicated motor driver is usually necessary, and even advanced controllers such as [product_name] ([version_no]) can handle stepper control but require more advanced setup and effort.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects [product_name] 24CE, in combination with [product_name] Power and [product_name] Contact, to directly manage a stepper motor’s speed, direction, and timed operation ideally without additional hardware.
